Law No. 59-ФЗ, Article 8. This is the forwarding deadline, not the deadline for resolving the problem. In the training profile, the starting day is excluded and a non-working final day moves to the next working day. No extension applies under the scenario. Identify the triggering event and deadline for the specifically named action.
